title: AdamW Optimizer Step
signature: def adamw_step(param, grad, m, v, t, lr=1e-3, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-8, weight_decay=1e-2) -> tuple
hints: Weight decay never touches the gradient or the moments. m and v are computed from the raw grad.
Decay the parameters directly: param * (1 - lr * weight_decay). The decay is scaled by lr.
Then apply the ordinary bias-corrected Adam step, with eps outside the square root.
